patterns.message: Deep relative imports are not allowed. Use the '@/' or '@shared/' alias instead.

Widget domain code is shared with the server bundle: it may import ONLY zod, @shared/*, './' siblings and JS/Temporal globals. This is an allowlist — everything else is blocked, including Reatom, React, widget-runtime/widget-sdk, any other npm package, the '@/' alias, and any '../' escape out of domain/ (rspack externalizes every request that does not start with '.', '@shared' or '@widgets', and the server image installs only packages/server's prod dependencies).

Widget domain tests may import ONLY vitest, zod, @shared/* and './' siblings. Reatom, React, widget-runtime/widget-sdk, other npm packages and '../' escapes are blocked here too — needing one would prove the domain module under test is not actually dependency-free.
